_comment: Five quotes captured during the NC campaign pilot, held as DRAFTS and NOT inserted.
Every one was verified against the raw bytes of https://mattfordurham.com/platform with no model
in the loop, because WebFetch is a known quote-fabricator. All five are present and verbatim.
They are parked here rather than in essentials.quotes because Kopac seated NO stance rows in this
batch: all seven of his proposed chairs rested on a campaign platform page and named no
instrument. A quote is worth keeping; a chair pinned on a promise is not.
Season 2 owns promotion. Research CSVs are gitignored, so this file is the surviving record.

quotes.quote_text: Identify public land and broker public-private partnerships to build more long-term affordable units
quotes.quote_deidentified: Identify public land and broker public-private partnerships to build more long-term affordable units
quotes.editor_note: This platform line commits to public land use and partnerships to fund affordable housing, matching the require-inclusion-and-publicly-fund position in stance 2; verbatim, no edits.

quotes.quote_text: Produce more affordable units and missing middle housing through local revolving construction loan programs, streamlined permitting for pre-approved affordable designs, and a revised Unified Development Ordinance
quotes.quote_deidentified: Produce more affordable units and missing middle housing through local revolving construction loan programs, streamlined permitting for pre-approved affordable designs, and a revised Unified Development Ordinance
quotes.editor_note: This is his own platform language calling for modest density increases like missing-middle housing rather than a full zoning overhaul, matching stance 2; verbatim, no edits.

quotes.quote_text: Maintain free bus service and expand local and regional transit to conveniently and affordably connect people from where they live to where they work and play
quotes.quote_deidentified: Maintain free bus service and expand local and regional transit to conveniently and affordably connect people from where they live to where they work and play
quotes.editor_note: This is a direct commitment to transit as the top transportation priority, matching stance 1's focus on transit, walking, and cycling investment; verbatim, no edits.

quotes.quote_text: Develop an economic strategy that supports our local businesses and promotes environmental sustainability, while diversifying our tax base to take tax pressure off low-income and fixed-income homeowners
quotes.quote_deidentified: Develop an economic strategy that supports [the local business community] and promotes environmental sustainability, while diversifying [the] tax base to take tax pressure off low-income and fixed-income homeowners
quotes.editor_note: This platform line commits to supporting local businesses rather than large employer subsidies, matching stance 2; edited only to remove the first-person "our" so the community cannot be identified.

quotes.quote_text: Grow the HEART program to bring compassionate alternatives to more situations that are non-violent
quotes.quote_deidentified: Grow [a program similar to HEART] to bring compassionate alternatives to more situations that are non-violent
quotes.editor_note: This platform line commits to expanding an unarmed co-responder program for non-violent calls, matching stance 2; edited to remove the specific program name since it identifies the city.
